package.description: Filesystem companion to the docgen plugin: render workspace files, mint files into blob refs, materialize artifacts back. Delegates rendering to `docgen` (mandatory dep); no component of its own.

tools.name: docgen_workspace
tools.description: Render a workspace file in one call: paths are minted into blob refs, the render is delegated to `docgen_compose`, the artifact is written back. Args: action, format, source (path), assets? [{name,path}|path], out?, kind?, surface?.

tools.name: docgen_file_to_blob
tools.description: Mint a workspace file into a blob ref (sha256:…) for chaining with docgen_compose or other tools. Args: path.

tools.name: docgen_blob_to_file
tools.description: Materialize a blob ref (artifact digest) into a workspace file. Args: ref, path.
